cpsFeature.note: The chrome-platform-showcase suite at conformanceRoute governs only the assertions it explicitly lists; it does not prove unasserted native, hardware, permission, backend, or other behavior. gendn references that listed contract without forking it.

assertions.describe: The stable route /v151/protocol-filtering-in-digital-credential-api/ responds 200 (durable-demo contract).
Page carries its canonical chromestatus.com/feature/6492906882990080 link — the immutable feature identity (CLAUDE.md invariant #3) and the milestone-151 mapping's self-heal.
Document has a non-empty <title> for the reference page.
Exactly one <h1> — the API name (listing name), MDN-shaped article heading.
A single <main> landmark wraps the article content.
Shared editorial design system /public/styles.css is linked.
Responsive viewport meta present (width=device-width) for mobile+desktop parity.
Breadcrumb links back to the /v151/ release index.
Byline footer present (article provenance).
Every target=_blank link carries rel=noopener (no reverse-tabnabbing; MDN-style external link hygiene).
No anchor has an empty or placeholder (#) href.
assertions.test: [...document.querySelectorAll('a')].every(el => { const h = el.getAttribute('href'); return h && h !== '#'; })

assertions.describe: Page loads with no console errors.
No failed (>=400 / net-error) network requests on load.
No unintended horizontal overflow at desktop (1280x800).
No unintended horizontal overflow at narrow mobile (360x740, DPR3).
Desktop render is legible, contrast passes WCAG AA, controls/text not clipped (screenshot review).
Mobile render is legible with adequate tap targets and no clipped text/controls (screenshot review).
The <h1> is the chromestatus milestone-listing name for this feature (not the broader detail name) — factual/source fidelity.
Frontend implementation consulted modern-web-guidance for its UI/responsive/a11y topics and applied or justified them (recorded in _questions.json guidanceConsulted).
Built reference has at least three <h2> sections (MDN-shaped depth).
Cross-browser support is documented (a support/compat/baseline section, or a reference table stating Baseline / Shipped-in / standards positions) — accurate messaging, not implied support.
Built reference includes a usable example surface (<pre> code and/or a live embed).
Code/IDL examples are correctly escaped (no attribute/element injection, invariant #4) and trace to the cited spec/IDL — no invented members (source review).
Experimental / origin-trial / behind-a-flag feature shows the mandatory .warn-block with enable steps (CLAUDE.md invariant #7).

Embedded live example points at THIS feature's chrome-platform-showcase route (chrome-platform-showcase.paulkinlan-ea.deno.net/v151/protocol-filtering-in-digital-credential-api...) — the canonical demo identity, never repointed.

The embedded chrome-platform-showcase demo actually renders (not a blank box or error frame); its platform behavior is governed by the CPS conformance contract referenced in cpsFeature, not re-asserted here.
The two stable reference routes (userAgentAllowsProtocol static method; protocol member + enumerations) resolve with HTTP 200 and each renders all nine dimension sections with substantive text.
assertions.test: (async () => { const dims = ['syntax','inputs','outputs','errors','context','lifecycle','examples','compatibility','security-privacy']; for (const m of ["useragentallowsprotocol/","protocol-member/"]) { const r = await fetch('./' + m); if (r.status !== 200) return false; const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(await r.text(), 'text/html'); for (const d of dims) { const el = doc.getElementById(d); if (!el || el.parentElement.textContent.trim().length < 40) return false; } } return true; })()

assertions.describe: The overview links every inventory member route.

Executable doc-quality check: the exact error contract is documented — unknown protocol identifier returns false WITHOUT throwing; undefined DigitalCredential interface throws ReferenceError; the typeof guard is required.
assertions.test: (async () => { const t = (await (await fetch('./useragentallowsprotocol/')).text()).replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' '); if (!/returns? false[^.]{0,60}without throwing|never (an exception|throws)/i.test(t)) return false; if (!/ReferenceError/.test(t)) return false; return /typeof DigitalCredential !== "undefined"/.test(t); })()

assertions.describe: Executable doc-quality check: request protocol is already required; DigitalCredential.protocol is readonly and uses the DigitalCredentialProtocol union typedef; the current closed enums list exactly four presentation values and one issuance value; arbitrary values outside the registry are the deprecation target.
assertions.test: (async () => { const t = (await (await fetch('./protocol-member/')).text()).replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' '); for (const v of ['openid4vp-v1-unsigned','openid4vp-v1-signed','openid4vp-v1-multisigned','org-iso-mdoc','openid4vci-v1']) { if (!t.includes(v)) return false; } return /required DOMString protocol/.test(t) && /typedef \(DigitalCredentialPresentationProtocol or DigitalCredentialIssuanceProtocol\) DigitalCredentialProtocol/.test(t) && /readonly attribute DigitalCredentialProtocol protocol/.test(t) && /arbitrary values outside|arbitrary protocol identifiers outside/i.test(t); })()

assertions.describe: Executable doc-quality check: BCD API availability is separate from the ChromeStatus 151/160 arbitrary-protocol filtering timeline; #enable-experimental-web-platform-features is the Chrome flag and DigitalCredentialsProtocolFilter is identified separately as the Finch/Blink runtime token.
assertions.test: (async () => { for (const p of ['', ...["useragentallowsprotocol/","protocol-member/"]]) { const html = await (await fetch('./' + p)).text(); if (!html.includes('api/DigitalCredential.json') || !html.includes('chromestatus.com/api/v0/features/6492906882990080')) return false; const t = html.replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' '); if (!/151/.test(t) || !/160/.test(t) || !/arbitrary/i.test(t)) return false; } const ov = (await (await fetch('./')).text()).replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' '); return /#enable-experimental-web-platform-features/.test(ov) && /DigitalCredentialsProtocolFilter/.test(ov) && /Finch\/Blink runtime/.test(ov); })()
